versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.6 — Updated documentation for clarity and accuracy

- Clarified that the skill works with all mainstream AI coding tools.
- Improved safety and compliance notes, emphasizing local-only operation and manual review.
- Enhanced important notes to highlight verification of outputs before use.
- No code or feature changes; documentation only.

- Added a new "Safety & Compliance" section to the documentation, highlighting security audits and ClawScan certification.
- Clarified that the skill does not execute code, access credentials, collect data, or make external network calls.
- Emphasized compliance with platform policies and suitability for AI coding tools.
- No file or functionality changes; this is a documentation and trust update only.

- Updated display name and description to clarify auto-activation, target audience, and token savings (now explicitly "Cut 40%–60% Tokens (Auto)").
- Added "Applicable Scenarios" section highlighting compatibility with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Gemini CLI).
- Introduced an "Important Notes" section warning users to review results for subtle detail loss or conditional expression changes.
- No changes to core functionality or features.

- Added real-world demos for code minification, log compression, and technical prompt optimization.
- Each demo includes original input, optimized output, and estimated token savings.
- Clarified display of before/after transformation for better transparency.
- Improved documentation on usage scenarios and advantages.
- No code changes; documentation update only.

- Removed README.md file.
- Updated description to specify 40%~60% token reduction and clarify use cases.
- Improved feature list and added comparison examples in SKILL.md.
- Adjusted tags and auto_activates triggers for more accurate activation.
- Documented usage instructions for both auto and command triggers.
